title: Pay gaming machine tax
what: Pay tax each month on the gross profits from gaming machines in the hotel or club.

sources.title: Gaming Control Act 1993 (Tas)
sources.quote: A venue operator must pay to the Commissioner of State Revenue a tax on the gross profits derived by that operator from gaming machine games each month
